/.title: Explore space
/.description: Explore NASA pictures, mission histories, Earth observations, and space trivia in an independent educational app.

/apod.title: Astronomy Picture of the Day
/apod.description: Browse NASA astronomy pictures by archive date, read the full explanation, and save discoveries in your browser.

/missions.title: Mission Archive
/missions.description: Explore source-checked histories of ten landmark space missions, from Apollo to Webb.

/trivia.title: Space Trivia
/trivia.description: Test your space knowledge with NASA-sourced questions, explanations, and references.

/earth.title: Earth Observatory
/earth.description: Explore archived DSCOVR EPIC Earth imagery and MODIS global composites. These observations are not live video.

/space-weather.title: Space Weather Center
/space-weather.description: Browse NASA DONKI solar and geomagnetic observations with research context. Not an operational forecast.

/asteroids.title: Asteroid Watch
/asteroids.description: Explore NASA near-Earth asteroid approach records, distances, and sizes with responsible risk context.

/media.title: NASA Media Library
/media.description: Search NASA photography, video, and audio with original archive metadata.

/favorites.title: Personal Flight Log
/favorites.description: Reopen discoveries saved in this browser. Saved records are local and are not shared through this link.

/about.title: About
/about.description: Learn about this independent NASA-data explorer, its sources, accessibility, and reliability.

/search.title: Unified Discovery Index
/search.description: Search NASA imagery, mission records, and educational material across the app.

/investigate.title: Investigation Workspace
/investigate.description: Explore related NASA records and sources in an investigation workspace.
